text: I'm looking after my granddaughter tonight, she's 14 months. Temperature is 39.9, I've checked it with the ear thermometer and again under the arm to be sure. The reason I'm writing is she has some spots I'm not happy about. She's got dark skin so it's not easy to see anything on her arms or tummy, but I had a look at the paler bits like her palms, the soles of her feet and inside her bottom eyelids, and there are tiny dark red pinprick dots there. I pressed a glass against her hand and they did not fade, you could still see them clear as anything through the glass. I did it twice to be certain. I've raised three children and I don't panic easily, but I know you're meant to take that glass thing seriously. Her parents are away overnight and I'm the one with her. Tell me what I need to do and I'll do it, if that means going in now then fine.
